items.maltese: Meta nkun fil-post favorit tiegħi, inħossni ferħan / ferħana.
items.english: When I am in my favourite place, I feel happy.

items.maltese: Meta nkun ħdejn il-baħar, inħossni kalm / kalma.
items.english: When I am near the sea, I feel calm.

items.maltese: Meta jkolli ħafna xogħol, inħossni inkwetat / inkwetata.
items.english: When I have a lot of work, I feel worried.

items.maltese: Meta niltaqa' mal-ħbieb, inħossni kuntent / kuntenta.
items.english: When I meet my friends, I feel content.

items.maltese: Meta jkolli aħbar tajba, inħossni eċitat / eċitata.
items.english: When I have good news, I feel excited.

items.maltese: Meta nagħmel żball, inħossni imbarazzat / imbarazzata.
items.english: When I make a mistake, I feel embarrassed.

answer.maltese: Inħossni kalm / kalma meta nkun ħdejn il-baħar.
answer.english: I feel calm when I am near the sea.

answer.maltese: Iva, xi kultant inħossni imdejjaq / imdejqa.

answer.english: The sea makes me feel relaxed.

items.maltese: Xi kultant inħossni nervuż / nervuża, imma meta nitkellem mal-ħbieb nikkalma.
